newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex to spend $1 bln in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Telmex to spend $1 bln in 1997.

text.p: Former Mexican telephone monopoly Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) plans to invest some $1 billion this year in capital expenditures, Telmex director general Jaime Chico Pardo said on Monday.

Telmex spent $550 million during 1996 but will spend nearly double that amount this year in modernising its network to compete with new rivals, Chico Pardo said during a news conference in this southeastern Mexican city.
The phone giant had said in December that it would spend $800 million in 1997 improving its network.
Chico Pardo said the start of competition in the long-distance market would force Telmex to focus on making local and public telephone services as profitable as possible.
A host of competitors, including companies backed by AT&T and MCI Communications, began competing against Telmex this year.
